metadata.title: [FEATURE]: OAuth Resource UI field, origin fallback, and softened auto-derived validation
metadata.author: jonpspri

description:
## Summary

Implements the maintainer-recommended **Option-2 hybrid** approach for issue #4384, plus complementary hardening.  Stacked on top of #4475 (the bugfix corrections); base must be #4475 not ``main``.

## What's in this PR

### Feature: closes the remaining #4384 acceptance criteria

- **UI Resource (Audience) field** in all four OAuth configuration forms (gateway create + edit, A2A agent create + edit) in ``mcpgateway/templates/admin.html``.  Form parsing in ``mcpgateway/admin.py`` extracts ``oauth_resource`` and merges it into ``oauth_config["resource"]``.  Pre-population on edit dialogs in ``mcpgateway/admin_ui/gateways.js`` and ``a2aAgents.js`` (handles both string and list shapes).  Multi-resource via comma-separated input per RFC 8707.
- **Origin-extraction fallback** (``_derive_resource_origin`` in ``mcpgateway/routers/oauth_router.py``): when no resource is configured, derive ``scheme://netloc`` from ``gateway.url`` (instead of full path).  Real OAuth providers (Salesforce, Azure AD, Okta) issue origin-level audiences.
- **Softened validation for auto-derived resources**: ``TokenValidationResult.audience_authoritative: bool = True``.  When ``False`` (resource auto-derived from gateway URL), audience mismatch becomes advisory and stays out of ``blocking_errors`` — the upstream MCP server is allowed to be the authoritative validator.  Configured/learned ``resource`` mismatches remain blocking.

### Hardening: defense-in-depth around audience learning

- **Shape validation** (``_is_well_formed_audience``): rejects malformed token_aud / persisted resource values (numbers, empty containers, mixed-type lists).
- **Issuer pinning**: when ``oauth_config["issuer"]`` is configured, refuse to persist audience if token's ``iss`` doesn't match (trailing slashes normalized).  Prevents cross-IdP audience bleed.
- **Trust-model documentation**: factored shared JWT decoder ``_decode_token_claims_unverified`` with explicit docstring documenting *why* signatures aren't verified at learning time and where the actual security boundary lies.
- **Diagnostic logs**: DEBUG breadcrumbs on each silent skip path (malformed aud, resource already set, issuer mismatch, decode failure) so operators can chase ""audience never learned"" reports.

### Tests

- 27 tests in ``TestPersistLearnedAudience`` (was 6 in #4404)
- 13 ``TestExtractTokenClaims`` tests for the JWT extractors (audience + issuer)
- Round-trip validation tests for opaque learned audiences
- Multi-user regression test for first-write-only semantics
- Validator authoritative/advisory split tests

## Stack

| | Branch | Status |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | ``bugfix/oauth-aud-resource-narrow`` | #4475 — must merge first |
| **2** | ``feat/oauth-aud-resource-hybrid`` | **this PR** |
| 3 | ``docs/oauth-audience-handling`` | #4477 |

## Acceptance criteria from #4384

| AC | Status |
|---|---|
| OAuth Resource field visible in Admin UI | ✅ this PR |
| Auto-derives origin if not set | ✅ this PR |
| Explicitly configured resource blocks on mismatch | ✅ this PR |
| Auto-derived resource logs warnings but doesn't block | ✅ this PR |
| Existing gateways without resource field continue working | ✅ this PR |
| Salesforce OAuth flow succeeds without manual config | ✅ this PR (origin fallback) |
| Documentation updates | follow-up PR (``docs/oauth-audience-handling``) |
| Playwright UI tests | not in scope |

## Verification

- 496 affected unit tests pass
- 17 doctests pass
- ``ruff check`` clean on changed files

commits.message:
fix(oauth): preserve opaque audience identifiers during token refresh

The refresh path's normalize_resource() previously dropped any non-URL
resource value as 'invalid', which discarded audiences learned at OAuth
callback time from IdPs that do not honor RFC 8707 (ServiceNow, Authentik,
etc. set aud=client_id rather than the requested resource URL).  This
caused validation to regress to the unfixed-bug state on the first token
refresh after callback, defeating the audience-learning fix.

Treat values lacking a URL scheme as opaque audience identifiers and pass
them through verbatim so they round-trip through refresh.  RFC 8707 §2
explicitly permits the AS to map resource to an abstract identifier.

Update existing 'invalid_resource' tests to assert the new pass-through
behavior on the wire, and rename them to reflect the corrected semantics.

Signed-off-by: Jonathan Springer <jps@s390x.com>
commits.author: Jonathan Springer

commits.message:
fix(oauth): restrict learned-audience persistence to first-write only

The /oauth/callback handler runs _persist_learned_audience() after every
successful authorization-code exchange, mutating gateway.oauth_config to
record the IdP's audience claim.  However, the route only enforces
gateway access (read-equivalent), not gateways.update -- so any user with
gateway access could silently overwrite shared global configuration on
behalf of all other users on every callback.  On a public/shared gateway
this is a 'last user to OAuth wins' shared-state mutation.

Restrict persistence to first-write-only semantics: the learned audience
is now written only when oauth_config['resource'] is currently unset.
To re-learn after an IdP change, an admin must clear the resource field
via the gateway update API, which does enforce gateways.update.

Promote the persistence log line to INFO so the privileged mutation is
visible in production logs.

Tests:
- Rename test_skips_when_resource_already_matches to ..._set_to_same_value
  to clarify the new semantics (skip on any set value, not just match).
- Add test_skips_when_resource_already_set_to_different_value as a
  regression guard for the authorization gap closure.

Signed-off-by: Jonathan Springer <jps@s390x.com>
commits.author: Jonathan Springer

commits.message:
fix(oauth): treat falsy persisted resource as unset for re-learning

_persist_learned_audience compared the existing resource with 'is not None',
which treated empty strings and empty lists as 'already set' and blocked
re-learning forever.  Use Python truthiness so an empty string or empty
list counts as unset, allowing an admin to clear the field via the gateway
update API and trigger re-learning on the next callback (recovery path
after stale config or IdP migration).

Adds a parametrized regression test for empty string and empty list as
persisted-resource values.

Signed-off-by: Jonathan Springer <jps@s390x.com>
commits.author: Jonathan Springer

commits.message:
fix(oauth): harden audience learning with issuer pinning and shape checks

Address follow-up review feedback for the audience-learning fix to make
the trust model defensible end-to-end and the data path defensive against
unexpected IdP responses.

Production code changes:

- Factor the unverified JWT decode into _decode_token_claims_unverified()
  with a docstring explicitly documenting the trust model: signatures and
  exp/iss/aud are NOT verified; this path is for non-authoritative
  metadata extraction only; authoritative validation happens upstream
  when the token is presented to the protected resource.

- Add _extract_token_issuer() paralleling _extract_token_audience(); both
  now reuse the shared decoder.  complete_authorization_code_flow returns
  token_iss alongside token_aud.

- _persist_learned_audience() now runs two defensive checks before
  writing.  Shape validation: token_aud must be a non-empty string or
  non-empty list of non-empty strings; numbers, empty containers, mixed
  lists, and dicts are silently dropped so a malformed IdP response
  cannot pollute persisted state.  Issuer pinning: when oauth_config has
  an 'issuer' configured, the token's iss must match it -- prevents a
  stale or misrouted token from a different AS injecting an audience
  for the wrong IdP.  When no issuer is configured, behavior is
  unchanged.

- Tighten _extract_token_audience return type from Any to
  Optional[Union[str, List[str]]]; reject claim values whose type
  doesn't match (numbers, mixed-type lists, dicts).

Test changes:

- TestExtractTokenClaims (test_oauth_manager.py): 13 unit tests covering
  the audience and issuer extractors -- string, list, missing claim,
  unexpected types, mixed list, opaque token, malformed JWT, empty
  input.

- TestPersistLearnedAudience (test_oauth_router.py): parametrized
  shape-validation test plus 4 issuer-pinning tests (no issuer
  configured, matching iss, mismatching iss, missing iss).

- test_token_validation_service.py: 2 round-trip tests confirming an
  opaque learned aud (string and list) successfully validates against
  the persisted opaque resource (the flagship PR scenario).

- test_oauth_manager.py: existing assertion on
  complete_authorization_code_flow result dict updated to expect the new
  token_iss field.

Signed-off-by: Jonathan Springer <jps@s390x.com>
commits.author: Jonathan Springer

commits.message:
fix(oauth): add diagnostic logs and multi-user regression test for audience learning

Final follow-up bundle from review feedback:

- Diagnosability (S4): emit DEBUG breadcrumbs on each silent skip path so
  operators chasing 'audience never learned' reports can distinguish
  between the causes:
  * _decode_token_claims_unverified logs when an exception is caught --
    distinguishes 'token was opaque' (normal) from 'JWT library raised
    something unexpected' (worth investigating).  DEBUG level keeps it
    out of production logs by default but available when troubleshooting.
  * _persist_learned_audience logs when token_aud is malformed/absent
    and when the resource is already set (first-write skip).  The
    issuer-mismatch breadcrumb already existed.

- Docstring (M5): add explicit Returns: section to
  _persist_learned_audience documenting the side-effect-only contract
  (oauth_config mutation + db.flush).

- Multi-user regression test (M2): explicit guard for first-write-only
  semantics under the multi-user scenario.  Two users complete the
  callback against the same shared gateway with different audience
  values; the second user's callback must observe the already-set
  resource and skip its write entirely.  This keeps the protection
  visible even if the short-circuit logic is later refactored.

- Test coverage for the new DEBUG logs: parametrized shape-validation
  test now asserts the breadcrumb is emitted; new test confirms decode
  failure logs at DEBUG; complement test confirms empty-input
  short-circuit does NOT log (would be noise).

Signed-off-by: Jonathan Springer <jps@s390x.com>
commits.author: Jonathan Springer

commits.message:
feat(oauth): expose Resource field in UI, derive origin fallback, soften auto-derived validation

Implement the maintainer-recommended Option-2 hybrid approach for issue #4384
on top of the auto-learn fix:

UI: OAuth Resource (Audience) field
- Add 'Resource (Audience)' input next to Issuer URL in all four OAuth
  configuration forms (gateway create + edit, A2A agent create + edit) in
  templates/admin.html.
- Wire up form parsing in admin.py to extract oauth_resource and merge it
  into oauth_config['resource']; supports comma-separated multi-value input
  per RFC 8707, stored as str when one value or list when multiple.
- Pre-populate the field on edit dialogs from gateway.oauthConfig.resource
  in admin_ui/gateways.js and admin_ui/a2aAgents.js (handles both string
  and list shapes).

Origin-extraction fallback (replaces full-URL fallback)
- Add _derive_resource_origin() in oauth_router.py: returns scheme+netloc
  only, dropping path/query/fragment.  Returns None for URN / scheme-less
  inputs so the caller falls back to auto-learn.
- /oauth/authorize and /oauth/callback now use this helper instead of the
  full-path _normalize_resource_url(gateway.url) when no resource is
  configured.  This matches real OAuth provider behavior (Salesforce,
  Azure AD, Okta typically issue origin-level audiences).

Softened validation for auto-derived resources
- TokenValidationResult gains audience_authoritative: bool = True.  When
  False, audience mismatch is dropped from blocking_errors so the token
  still forwards (the upstream MCP server is the authoritative validator).
- _validate_audience() sets audience_authoritative = bool(configured_resource)
  on mismatch.  Configured (admin-set or learned) -> blocking; gateway-URL
  fallback -> advisory.

Tests
- Origin-extraction parametrized test (5 hierarchical URLs + 6 non-URL
  inputs) covers the new helper.
- Validator authoritative/advisory split: 4 new tests on
  TokenValidationResult.blocking_errors and validate_oauth_token_claims
  covering configured-resource (blocking) and no-resource fallback
  (advisory) paths.

Closes the remaining #4384 acceptance criteria gaps:
- 'OAuth Resource field is visible in Admin UI'
- 'Auto-derives origin if not set'
- 'Auto-derived resource logs warnings but doesn't block'
- 'Existing gateways without resource field continue working'

Signed-off-by: Jonathan Springer <jps@s390x.com>
commits.author: Jonathan Springer
